system.description:
A victim hit by a missile with this talent must make a saving throw vs. spells (at a +2 bonus to the roll) or be teleported to a point [[/r 1d100 #Miles]] miles away, with the direction and distance determined randomly. Unlike the effect of the magic-user spell, the victim cannot arrive in the air or within a solid object.

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.

Fletched arrows in a quiver. Can be used with a long bow or short bow. These arrows are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.
